::: {.callout-note .legacy appearance="simple"}
This post is from the blog I kept as Preceptor in Mathematics at Harvard (2005–2008). It's kept here as an archive; some links are dead and references are dated.
:::

I wrote a notebook called\
[Critical Points](http://abel.math.harvard.edu/~leingang/2005/04/06/CriticalPoints/) to demonstrate why we need to look at *all* critical points of a function, not just the points with horizontal tangents, to find local maxima and minima.
